subject: Re: Equinox AI - request for larger initial grant (context-heavy POC)
messages:
From: Sam Park <sam.park@equinox.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Equinox POC - larger initial grant request

Hi Karthik / Laura,

Thanks again for the quick demo earlier. Our POC will be focused on long-document understanding for enterprise contracts — we plan to load multi-document packs (~40–70k tokens each) and run iterative reranking + extractive QA, so token usage and TPM will be much higher than a standard PLG signup.

Quick ask: can Redwood increase the standard initial free grant for Equinox to cover roughly 1,000,000 tokens (we estimate ~250k tokens/day for a 4 day active evaluation window) and extend the trial TTL to 30 days? That buys us enough runway to validate accuracy at scale.

Attached is a short POC scope summary with traffic shape and SLOs. Happy to hop on a call if you need more detail.

—Sam
Sam Park
Head of ML Engineering, Equinox AI
sam.park@equinox.ai
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: POC_scope_summary.pdf (1 page - token shapes, expected TPM)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@equinox.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 12:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Equinox POC - larger initial grant request

Sam — thanks for the details and the PDF.

I'm looping in Laura (enterprise sales) and Vivek (dedicated operations) to confirm the feasibility and any guardrails we should attach. A few internal notes we need to agree on before issuing:
- Requested grant: 1,000,000 tokens + 30 day TTL (confirm)
- Monitoring: token reporting + a weekly check-in — we reserve the right to throttle if sustained TPM exceeds the agreed band
- Billing/procurement: if they convert to Dedicated, credits will be evaluated against committed usage

Laura — would you be comfortable approving a provisional self-serve grant (EQX-GRANT-2026-54) with the above constraints? I'll prepare the issuance link and instructions once we have the ok.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Growth Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Equinox POC - larger initial grant request

Karthik / Vivek — quick thumbs up with conditions:

1) Approve provisional grant of 1,000,000 free tokens, TTL 30 days.
2) Cap sustained sustained throughput: allow bursts up to requested TPM but require that average TPM over a rolling 10-minute window stays under 40k; ops to throttle beyond that and notify both parties.
3) Require a 7-day check-in from Equinox to share evaluation metrics and a short usage recap doc.
4) Attach HubSpot deal EQX-2026-045 and flag for account exec follow-up (Laura B).

If procurement needs a DocuSign or PO for extended credits, we can handle that via the finance team, but this provisional grant can be issued now through the self-serve grants flow.

Vivek — please confirm if the ops constraints are implementable and whether you want a different throttle profile.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Equinox POC - larger initial grant request

Confirmed — ops can enforce a soft throttle at 40k TPM rolling average and allow configured burst capacity for 5 minute windows up to 60k TPM. We'll attach automated alerts to both the account and the infra on-call if thresholds are crossed. I'll also add a tag to the grant so we can automatically collect per-token cost reports for the account.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Dedicated Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@equinox.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@equinox.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Equinox POC - request for larger initial grant (context-heavy POC)

Sam / Priya — good news. Per internal approvals, we've provisionally issued a self-serve grant:

- Grant code: EQX-GRANT-2026-54
- Amount: 1,000,000 free tokens
- TTL: 30 days from issuance
- Throttle policy: 40k TPM rolling average (soft throttle); bursts allowed to 60k TPM for up to 5 minutes. Alerts will fire to the account and infra on-call if thresholds are exceeded.

How to redeem: visit https://redwood.cloud/self-serve/grants and enter the grant code (or follow the one-click link below). The grant will be applied to the Equinox org account (we matched on your signup email priya.shah@equinox.ai).

One more ask: please schedule a 20-minute check-in with Laura in 7 days so we can go over usage and any early findings. If procurement needs a PO or DocuSign for extended commitments, loop procurement@equinox.ai and mention deal EQX-2026-045.

Self-serve link (one-click): https://redwood.cloud/self-serve/grants/issue?code=EQX-GRANT-2026-54

Attachment: grant_instructions.md (contains step-by-step redeem & how to monitor usage)

Thanks and excited to see what you build.
Karthik Iyer
Director, Growth Engineering | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
